text: Accepted405 adds testSystemIntegrationDialog/testLanguageAndAppearanceDialogs and short Tests... JSDoc, as requested inD214684. Current family has renamed testLanguageAndFontsDialogs. These prove the expected page opens/closes without uncaught exceptions, not all functionality or accessibility. New sibling tests can follow this testCamelCase dialog family; current files also contain test_snake_case and anonymous tasks, so a global test-name rule is still a proposal.
title: Give dialog smoke tests names and short descriptions without overstating their coverage
